# Unserialize

> A stateless PHP serialized-data to JSON converter. Objects convert to their properties without their class being loaded, and input is limited to 262,144 bytes.

The HTML pages below (/, /guides/wordpress-serialized-data, /guides/fix-broken-serialized-string, /privacy, /developers) also serve a Markdown representation: send `Accept: text/markdown` and the page is returned as Markdown instead of HTML.

## Documentation

- https://unserialize.dev/: Browser converter, PHP serialization format, WordPress workflow, and security guidance
- https://unserialize.dev/guides/wordpress-serialized-data: Where WordPress stores serialized PHP and how to read and edit it safely
- https://unserialize.dev/guides/fix-broken-serialized-string: Diagnosing and repairing serialized strings that fail to unserialize
- https://unserialize.dev/privacy: Privacy and retention contract
- https://unserialize.dev/developers: HTTP API and MCP integration guide
- https://unserialize.dev/openapi.json: OpenAPI 3.1 description
